category: hosted authentication and user management (email, OAuth and magic links, teams, RBAC, analytics), managed Stack Auth now branded Hexclave

free_tier.stated: Free: USD 0 forever, up to 10,000 auth users, 1 dashboard admin, 1,000 emails per month, email, OAuth and magic links, community support; the usage table also lists 100K analytics events per month and 2,500 session replays per month
free_tier.notes: An auth user is any user account in the project; inactive users still count toward the limit, but accounts can be deleted. This is a total-account count, not a monthly-active-user count. The first-party pricing and sign-in pages now use the name Hexclave for the product formerly called Stack Auth; the stack-auth.com domain still serves it.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object or user-profile size cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no log or data retention period is stated on the pricing page; the page lists 2,500 session replays per month on every tier but does not state how long they are kept

egress.terms: not applicable: an authentication REST API; no traffic allowance or egress term is published

interface_detail: A REST API at api.hexclave.com/api/v1 for backends and frontends, authenticated with project ID plus a publishable client key for client access or a secret server key for server access; SDKs exist for Next.js, React, TanStack Start, JavaScript and TypeScript, with Python and other languages using the REST API. Hosted sign-in and sign-up component pages are served in a browser. The API answers 429 with retry headers when rate limited.
tooling: Hexclave SDKs (@hexclave/next, @hexclave/react, @hexclave/tanstack-start, @hexclave/js), the @hexclave/cli for local development and project commands, or any HTTP client against the REST API with project keys.
chaining: Login, teams and RBAC for an app on free hosting, with email delivery on the Free plan limited to 1,000 messages a month. A self-hostable server Docker image that the reader installs and runs is offered under the same brand, listed last and not counted as a hosted tier.

limits.value: 10,000 auth users (total accounts, including inactive ones) on Free
1 dashboard admin on Free; extra admins are USD 29 each per month on paid tiers
100K analytics events and 2,500 session replays per month on Free
REST API rate limits vary by endpoint and access type; exceeding them returns 429 Too Many Requests with retry headers

limits_note: The analytics and session-replay allowances are per-month volumes with no dedicated vocabulary kind and are recorded as volume-quota rows. SAML SSO has no connections on Free (3 then USD 99 each on Growth).
binding_note: The 10,000 auth-user ceiling binds first because inactive accounts also count; below it, the 1,000-emails-per-month cap limits a product that sends verification or magic-link mail.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: behind a sign-up. The hosted sign-in and sign-up pages run in a browser; no first-party capture of their form fields was obtained. The REST API uses a project ID with a publishable client key for client access or a secret server key for server access. No card requirement is stated on the pricing page, and the free tier starts at USD 0 forever. Whether the account form asks for a card, phone number or institution is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The API rate-limits by endpoint and access type and answers 429 with retry headers. The docs state the product changes rapidly and directs users to current documentation. No uptime SLA is on the Free tier; premium support and SLA are on Growth.
confidence_note: Pricing, usage definitions and API access are quoted from first-party pricing, homepage and API documentation pages. The signup form fields could not be captured from a first-party page and are left unverified. No account was opened and no live API probe was run.
